content.headline: Document intelligence — read 90 pages in 60 seconds
content.body: NotebookLM (and similar RAG tools) search your uploaded files first, then answer with page-level citations. That citation is the feature that answers "can I trust this?"
bullets: Upload a public policy PDF only — never confidential files
Run four prompts: summarize → deadlines with pages → FAQ → briefing note
Citations speed verification — they do not replace officer judgment
